title: Leaf from a Jain Manuscript: Yoga-shastra: Jain monk with Disciple and Two Laymen, Two Nuns and a Laywoman below (verso)
description: An illustrated palm-leaf manuscript of Hemachandra's Yoga-shastra, dated 1279, from western India (Gujarat). It illustrates Jain manuscript culture and is not a page from the Parishishtaparvan or an illustration of Bindusara's birth.
author: Medieval manuscript artist; text by Hemachandra; digital image: Cleveland Museum of Art
source: Cleveland Museum of Art, via Wikimedia Commons
collectionCredit: Purchase from the J. H. Wade Fund
